purpose: Conditional comparison of node-only and node-plus-market descriptions on registered restructuring events; no trading or causal claims
main_source_basis: active-run-linked P6A prior verified facts with matching current parent metadata, plus a separately versioned primary-bound manually reviewed court-stage clause pool; original title candidates remain separate and no AN alias identity is asserted
membership_basis: historical ST membership on the last benchmark session on or before information availability
prediction_time: after the information date closes; a date-only disclosure is not assumed available intraday
entry_basis: next benchmark session close, with no delayed entry selected from future price availability
price_source_rule: one source must contain every key in the 21-session outcome path; do not splice independently adjusted qfq snapshots
outcome: maximum drawdown along 21 adjusted closing prices from entry through entry+20; qfq price path is not old-shareholder wealth

estimator.standardization: continuous predictors using training data only

training: expanding past years; exclude training anchors whose outcome exit reaches the test year
primary_metric: paired MAE(node-only) minus MAE(node-plus-market), positive means smaller held-out prediction error with market features
missing_outcomes: retain all candidate anchors and reasons; do not fill suspensions, missing prices or delisted paths with zero; bound missing MAE differences over possible drawdown outcomes in [-1,0]
promotion: both uncertainty intervals must exclude zero positively, sample gates must pass and missing-outcome bounds must remain positive; even then retrospective candidate only
known_exposure: recent market weakness is a user-provided hypothesis; historical periods were used in earlier project studies and are not a pristine untouched holdout
outcome_execution_gate: capacity audit first, then numerical value validation and separate estimator implementation; this plan alone does not execute or validate an effect
information_date_review: Preserve original event and information dates. For the fixed active prior-fact source pool, use the latest of original information day, byte-bound reviewed issuer signature day and company/attachment-bound official CNINFO catalog day decoded in Asia/Shanghai. Catalog midnight milliseconds are a date field, not an exact release timestamp. Current metadata observation does not establish historical PIT, and title-only candidates are not promoted to body-verified facts.

new_public_court_source_policy.scope: company court-stage and explicitly reviewed dates only; not whole-body or P8 gold certification
new_public_court_source_policy.information_date: official company/attachment-bound catalog day; no exact release time or historical PIT claim
new_public_court_source_policy.actual_court_date: nullable; never substitute receipt, signature or catalog date
new_public_court_source_policy.deduplication: exact primary document or unresolved same-company/stage overlap with any prior fact is held; one company/stage per new pool
new_public_court_source_policy.selection: fixed title-stage/time frame before price values or outcomes are read
new_public_court_source_policy.price_and_sample_gates: unchanged; new primary-source admission is not window/value/effect validation
